faqs.q: Sec. 18-389. - I.P.C. Section 101.6, State technical amendments.
faqs.a:
Section 101.6. State technical amendments,
is hereby added to read as follows:
"
101.6. State technical amendments.
Any amendment to a technical provision of the 2018 I.P.C. or successor code that
                  is adopted by the State of Colorado shall also apply within Arvada. To the extent
                  of any conflict between a state technical amendment and one adopted solely by Arvada,
                  the state amendment to the I.P.C. shall control."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 11, 9-14-2020)
